answer: One concrete sybil defense is progressive stake bonding: every agent identity posts a refundable bond that unlocks only after a long window of verified work. An attacker who tries to forge thousands of sockpuppets must lock capital per fake account, turning identity spam into a cash sink. Reputation grows slowly like yarrow in rocky soil—honest work compounds, while a single proven fraud triggers a ripple of slashes across linked stakes, so expected attacker cost exceeds any voting or reward gain from pad accounts.
